content.text:
Found **two P2 issues** in [trail 181](https://entire.io/gh/entireio/entire-graph/trails/181), head `7de5a305`:

1. **Plural queries miss abbreviation retrieval.** `configuration` finds `loadConfig` and `applyConfigDefaults`; `configurations` finds neither in the supplied corpus. Alias expansion uses the terms captured before singularization. Expand aliases from normalized variants too.

2. **Logging phrases incorrectly generate `login`.** Both “log the error in json” and “log a message in json format” add `login`, raising authentication functions above relevant logging results. The object-head check does not distinguish a login particle from a formatting preposition.

::code-comment{title="[P2] Expand abbreviations from morphological variants" body="The abbreviation loop uses originalTerms, captured before morphological expansion. Consequently configurations produces configuration but never config or cfg, and both config functions disappear from the supplied retrieval corpus. Expand aliases from normalized variants as well." file="/tmp/entire-graph-review-181/internal/sem/search.go" start=5127 end=5129 priority=2}
::code-comment{title="[P2] Avoid interpreting logging formats as login" body="The separated-particle scan converts log the error in json and log a message in json format into login queries. Both reproduce, and the latter raises persistLogin above relevant logging results in the supplied corpus. Add a guard and regression coverage for formatting prepositions." file="/tmp/entire-graph-review-181/internal/sem/search.go" start=4983 end=4987 priority=2}

Existing semantic suite passed; added reproductions fail as described. CI: **25 passed**. Runners: **6 passed, semantic-diff not run**. Branch: **4 ahead, 0 behind**, conflict-free; human approval remains outstanding. No production changes made.
